name: sol_cr_6
description: Single-step ownership/privilege transfer instead of secure two-step transfer pattern
question: The source file in `source` implements a privileged role transfer function (e.g., transferOwnership, setAdmin, changeOwner) that immediately overwrites the current owner/admin state variable with the new address in one call, without requiring the new address to explicitly accept or claim the role via a separate pendingOwner/acceptOwnership step, allowing an irrecoverable loss of privileges if the wrong address is supplied, excluding cases where the function already implements a two-step propose-then-accept mechanism or only renounces the role to zero address intentionally.
criteria: transferOwnership(address newOwner) sets owner = newOwner directly in a single call with no pendingOwner staging variable
setAdmin(address newAdmin) immediately overwrites admin = newAdmin without requiring newAdmin to call an acceptAdmin/claimAdmin function
changeOwner directly assigns the storage owner variable from the caller-provided argument with no two-step handshake or confirmation step
onlyOwner-guarded function updates the privileged role address in one transaction without emitting a pending-transfer event or storing a candidate address for later acceptance
